name: Chii-chan no "Chi" wa Chikan no "Chi"
original_name: ちいちゃんの「ち」は痴漢の「ち」
source:
The heartful story of a constantly-groped OL.

Chihiro "Chi-chan" Suginoki is molested every day.

Every. Day.

Train or bus. Bus or train.
She has to ride.

And every time, she attracts the chikans.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE162632.html]DLsite English[/url]]
